name: morambol-boq-intelligence
description: Morambol Supplies — BOQ Price Intelligence System with multi-format intake, OCR, and Labour Rate Engine

notes.canvas: Native peer dependency of pdfjs-dist for server-side PDF page rendering. Requires node-gyp and build tools. Netlify builds include the required toolchain automatically.
notes.xlsx: Used via CDN in public/index.html for browser-side XLSX parsing. Also bundled by esbuild for server-side use in search-prices.js.
notes.tesseract.js: ~15 MB bundle. Large scanned BOQs (>500 KB / ~10+ pages) are automatically routed to the Background Function (ocr-intake-background.js) which has a 15-minute timeout.
notes.pdfjs-dist: Used to render scanned PDF pages to PNG images before passing to Tesseract.js. Requires canvas as a peer dependency.
notes.sharp: Image pre-processing before OCR: greyscale conversion + 30% contrast boost for better Tesseract accuracy.
notes.mammoth: DOCX to plain text extraction. Preserves table structure for column detection.
notes.pdf-parse: Text-layer extraction for non-scanned (digital) PDFs. Fast and lightweight.
